preconditions.description: The number of cards n must be between 1 and 100.
The required total power k must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= 1000 and 1 <= ci <= 100000 and 1 <= li <= n for pi, ci, li in cards)
preconditions.description: Each card's power pi, magic number ci, and level li must be within specified bounds.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any(sum(card[0] for card in selected_cards) >= k for selected_cards in valid_decks) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid deck can be formed, output -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min_level) if any(sum(card[0] for card in selected_cards) >= k for selected_cards in valid_decks) else True
postconditions.description: Output the minimum level required to form a valid deck with total power at least k.
